summary: Shared current source/installed F# controls must model each real caller profile, explicitly type ambiguous public records and accumulate singleton effect callbacks. Same-job source/tree/version/status/DLL guards protect reuse, one coherent pack and fresh locked cache remain, and all final model/Core/browser gates share the unchanged35-minute deadline. The control now checks full exact refusal, retired projection and mechanical/result stability.39009007033/a1 again built source then failed CLR with RequestOwnerUnavailable; source inspection exposed hardcoded SC2 ABI and queue assumptions in a generic BAR caller. The whole cohort now shares one typed ready fixture deriving descriptor ABI and immediately asserting worker/generation, compiled/initialized/idle/live state, exactly two successful setup settlements and no armed timers. An explicit applicability table retains all five SC2 reentry histories on default/selected SC2 through both facades; BAR uses queue-free timer/ancestor histories plus actual Busy refusal. That admitted-update refusal retains one Refused settlement while preserving current worker/request and no extra Post/Arm/termination; it must not be confused with effect-free precheck errors. A fresh subsequent BAR terminal dispatches once, preserves actual outcome and retires. All success/rejection/adapter/synchronous-result, cleanup/exact-once controls and downstream current suites remain, with case/profile/facade diagnostics. Whole-cohort independent source review and clean static/inert+canonical lock checks passed; no local CLR/Fable/model/browser workload ran. Seven generation inputs and71 accepted outputs are unchanged. Every original failure remains failed. Subsequent full PR qualifier39009544440/a1 and protected-main qualifier39010989001/a1 at5e2ebd8d1df0412d4725b31bcb8d380b3c85e48a actually passed the repaired cohort through source and exact-candidate installed CLR/Fable, full model/Core/browser suites and custody freeze/upload. The protected job took829seconds under the35-minute limit; independent data review accepted its original39-member artifact12092849150. This is one observed fit, not a general cold-cost guarantee. A later read-only publication preflight exposed a current checkout-log reader defect; its connected source correction requires fresh P=E qualification/custody and cannot reuse old package custody under a new executor. Publication and fresh both-feed served installation remain owed. Early failures now precede costly stages, but runtime/cost savings are not measured.
